brief.headline: 12,591 predicted passes within 5 km of a Starlink satellite in the next 24 hours, 464 of them within 1 km.
lines: Closest: STARLINK-3505 and GAOFEN-9 03 (China, satellite), predicted 6 m apart at 00:20 UTC, closing at 8.4 km/s.
Most passes: China (3,743) and United States (3,191); per object, 2.93 and 2.79.
2,392 passes involve rocket bodies or debris; China owns the most of that hardware.
Objects with no registered owner: 5.21 passes each, across 152 objects.
Over 46.4 days, 0% of HawkEye 360 satellites in Starlink's band were seen maneuvering.
Screened 11,156 Starlinks against 4,572 objects from public data. Screening grade, not collision probabilities.
